surfaces.notes: Built (lane ENTAPI-L16C, T-710) for Usage and Cost: driver internal/vendorapi/openrouter Activity (GET /api/v1/activity with no filter: the last 30 completed UTC days, one row per date, model and endpoint, aggregated across workspaces; unpaged; every run restates the 30 days). Tool attribution RULING: OpenRouter is a gateway route with no registry adapter, so every row lands as an UNATTRIBUTED org-level gateway fact under the reserved value gateway:openrouter (vendorapi.GatewayTool), never a registry tool: no tool figure arbitrates onto it, no identity is held under it, nothing on a spend, budget, alert or enforcement path reads it. Facts per (UTC day, model slug, endpoint id): cost and byok_cost (usd), requests, input, output, reasoning and cache_read tokens; cached_tokens may exceed prompt_tokens (documented) and is never subtracted. Adoption stays buildable (the per-user filter is not used). Closed DTO (secret class may_return_secret kept). Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. assumption_tested: the first row is the reference example, the second is synthesized.
